description: Create a project-level snapshot for either project status or ad hoc type. This is rate limited to one request per hour for each project and budget view, regardless of snapshot type.

id.description: Unique identifier of the budget view snapshot. Use as the {budget_view_snapshot_id} path parameter to retrieve its summary rows or detail rows.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the snapshot was created, in ISO 8601 format.

id.description: ID of the user who created the snapshot.

name.description: Full name of the user who created the snapshot.

login.description: Login email address of the user who created the snapshot.

budget_view.description: The budget view this snapshot was taken from.

id.description: ID of the budget view this snapshot was taken from.

snapshot_type.description: Kind of snapshot. Use filters[snapshot_type] to filter collections by this value.

approval_status.description: Review state of the snapshot. Present for project status snapshots; when a company-defined custom status applies, see the status object. Use filters[approval_status] to filter collections by this v...

status.description: The company-defined custom status assigned to the snapshot. Present for project status snapshots that have a custom status assigned.

name.description: Display name of the custom status.

mapped_to_status.description: The built-in status that this custom status maps to.

available.description: Whether the custom status can currently be selected for snapshots.

initial.description: Whether this custom status is the default applied to newly created snapshots.

standard_type.description: The underlying standard category of the custom status.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the custom status was created, in ISO 8601 format.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the custom status was last updated, in ISO 8601 format.

financial_period_id.description: Obsolete. Identifier of the financial period the snapshot is assigned to. Use the `financial_period` object instead; this field is retained only for backward compatibility.

date_range_for_actuals.description: Start and end dates that bound the actuals captured in the snapshot, in ISO 8601 format. Null when the snapshot was generated without an actuals date range.

include_actuals_without_dates.description: Whether actuals with no date were included alongside the date-ranged actuals when the snapshot was generated. Null when no actuals date range was applied.

forecast_start_date.description: Date from which forecasting calculations begin for this snapshot. Null when forecasting was not applied.

financial_period.description: The financial period the snapshot is assigned to. Present for project status snapshots that have a period assigned; null otherwise (including ad hoc snapshots).

name.description: Display name of the financial period

group_name.description: Name of the group the financial period belongs to

status.description: Whether the financial period is currently open or closed

start_date.description: First day of the financial period

end_date.description: Last day of the financial period

links.description: URLs for retrieving the row data captured in this snapshot.

detail_rows.description: URL to fetch the Snapshot Detail Rows for this budget view snapshot.

summary_rows.description: URL to fetch the Snapshot Summary Rows for this budget view snapshot.

503.description: Service Unavailable — Budget Tool is in maintenance mode for this company

budget_template_id.description: The budget template identifier (deprecated, use budget_view_id instead)

name.description: Title of the budget view snapshot

snapshot_type.description: Snapshot Type. Only available when Project Status Snapshots feature is enabled.

date_range_for_actuals.description:
Filters actuals data to a specific date range when generating the snapshot.
Provide exactly two dates in ISO 8601 format representing the start and end of the range.

only_actuals_with_dates.description:
When true, only actuals records with a date within date_range_for_actuals are included.
When false (default), actuals records with no date are also included alongside date-ranged results.

financial_period_id.description:
The ID of the Financial Period to associate with this snapshot.
Only available when the Financial Periods feature is enabled.
